name: Cartoon Fact Shorts
tagline: One fact, one fast chain of causes, read by a deadpan narrator over a moving 3D camera.
description: 30-second 9:16 explainers for one fact, process or true event. A flat, fast narrator runs a single cause-and-effect chain from the danger already happening to the final outcome. The world holds still like a diorama, the camera never stops gliding, each fact gets its own literal picture on the word that names it, and small white captions are the only text.
story: Opens on the threat or action already happening, with a concrete count, in one 11–14 word sentence
3–5 sentences, about 80–90 words, with the longest sentence second and the answer held back to the end
Every sentence links to the last one (so, while, until, as, next, just then); 'But' only for the twist and the payoff
Plain deadpan facts: no jokes, no opinion words, no moral, no outro
Second person present for processes in the viewer's own body or life, third person past for true events
Ends on the final physical outcome, worded so it loops back to the opening
look: Rendered with moco's 'film' look, the nearest it has to the reference's semi-real game-engine render: lit and finished like a 3D animated film, with no outlines
Uncluttered one-surface sets with the hero centred and one saturated accent colour kept for the key object
Bright, warm-subject-on-cool-sky grade for processes; dark, muted grade with overhead pools of light for dangerous events
The camera moves in nearly every shot: one eased move per shot, mostly push-ins, and the shot scale changes at every cut
People and props hold still apart from one short action timed to its word; faces stay neutral
A new picture about every 1.9 s, hard cuts placed mid-sentence, and small white 2–4 word captions
missing: Semi-real render with physically real materials: moco draws a stylised animated-film look instead
Realistic human stand-ins about 7 heads tall: drawn as stylised film characters
Arriving fast and easing to a cruise (speed profiles): each move is eased evenly from start to end
Blur, zoom-through and whip transitions: shots join with hard cuts
Material morph into a compared object (3-frame in-shot dissolve): shown as a cut to the familiar object instead
Surface going translucent to show the inside: shown as a cut to a cross-section location
Rack-focus reveals: focus stays on the subject
Hot emissive colour tint on a consequence: shown with a glowing object or a cut instead
Music bed 11–15 dB under the voice, -10 LUFS master and sound effects: not produced
Exact caption placement at 78% of frame height and the caption's drop-shadow styling: moco's caption layout is used

ideas.label: Lightning in a tree
ideas.idea: What happens inside an old oak in the half second after lightning hits it, from the sap boiling to the bark blowing off in strips.

ideas.label: Swallowing a pill
ideas.idea: The 9 seconds it takes your body to move one pill from your tongue to your stomach, and the 3 muscles that make sure it doesn't go the wrong way.

ideas.label: The frozen harbour
ideas.idea: How one winter night of falling temperature trapped a fishing fleet in harbour ice, and the one small boat whose engine broke them out.
